snippet.title: Shadow Fight Arena - Official PC Trailer
snippet.description:
Shadow Fight is coming to PC! Wishlist now: https://shadowfight.com/pc

Prepare for crossplay battles, with all your progress saved across all available platforms. Wishlist now to receive a unique weapon at launch!

Follow the news about Shadow Fight Arena on our social media:

1. https://www.facebook.com/shadowfightarena
2. https://twitter.com/SFArenaGame
3. https://discord.gg/shadowfight
